description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.

description.zh: 插件配置。Wasm 插件配置内容是 YAML 格式，Lua 插件配置内容是 Lua 代码。
description.en: The plug-in configuration. The configuration content of the WebAssembly (Wasm) plug-in is in the YAML format. The configuration content of the Lua plug-in is Lua code.

description.zh:
插件应用范围。

- 全局：0
- 路由：1
- 域名：2
description.en:
The application scope of the plug-in. Valid values:

*   0: global
*   1: route
*   2: domain name
Indicates whether the plug-in is enabled.
The unique ID of the gateway.

description.zh: 域名ID/路由ID列表（根据ConfigLevel区分）
description.en: The domain IDs or route IDs. They are distinguished based on ConfigLevel.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-plugin-config --gateway-unique-id gw-ubuwqygbq4783gqb2y3f87q0000 --plugin-id 20 --config-level 1 --config example-string --enable true --resource-id-list 200 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse CreatePluginConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigLevel 1 --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-ubuwqygbq4783gqb2y3f87q0000' --Config 'example-string' --Enable true --AcceptLanguage zh --ResourceIdList '[200]' --PluginId 20
